'''Clan Nerak''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan active during the [[Third Galactic War]]. During that period, Nerak was younger than many other clans and struggling to find its place in Mandalorian society. At one point, a rising young warrior named [[Ballag]] seized power in the clan, killing the leader after suffering what he considered a grave insult. Ballag claimed that the insult had constituted a legitimate challenge under Mandalorian tradition, but some people considered him a murderer.<ref name="Seeing Red" />

In an effort to improve his poor reputation, Ballag led Clan Nerak into fights with other clans. Around [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}</ref> he led an attack that killed a young [[Mandalorian shock trooper|warrior]] of the venerable [[Clan Shale]]. The [[Arbiter (Mandalorians)|Arbiter]] on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Jekiah Ordo]], intervened. He summoned Ballag along with [[Arla Shale|Arla]], leader of Clan Shale, and ordered them either to settle the feud with a duel or drop the matter. Ordo further stipulated that the loser's clan would be destroyed, a rare but not unheard-of measure in Mandalorian justice.<ref name="Seeing Red" />

Members of both clans, with a great crowd of onlookers, gathered in the Mandalorian arena on Geonosis to witness the unusually high-stakes duel. Arla stood her ground as Ballag launched a series of showy attacks that wounded his enemy but wore himself out. Then she struck back, pinning him with a [[Bayonet/Legends|bayonet]] and disarming him. But rather than kill him and doom Clan Nerak, Arla asked the Arbiter to declare the fight a draw. The clan was saved, but Ballag had lost their respect. Very soon after, he fell from power and Nerak had a new leader.<ref name="Seeing Red" />
